name: What should I prepare before hiring a finish carpenter for my garage?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before hiring a finish carpenter for my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparation starts by measuring the equipment, tools, and vehicles you intend to house in the space. Measure vehicle clearances with doors open to ensure custom workbenches or side-wall cabinets do not block your walking paths. You will also need to note the locations of electrical outlets, hose bibs, electrical panels, and access hatches. Sharing these measurements and clear photos during the initial consultation ensures the carpenter frames storage units with proper clearances and easy access to critical home utilities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the garage, measure vehicle clearances, identify utility panels, and list the specific gear you plan to store so your carpenter can design accurate layouts.
